title: Boop
blurb: A soft, friendly two-tone boop — the sound of tapping someone on the nose rendered in audio. It occupies a specific niche the internet genuinely needs: wholesome without being saccharine, cute without demanding anything. Streamers wire it to channel-point redemptions, editors drop it on gentle moments, and plenty of people press it simply because pressing a button labelled Boop and hearing a boop is a complete and satisfying experience in itself. Original synthesis, free to download, and the closest thing this soundboard has to a house sound.
origin: Original Bleepboard synthesis — the house boop.
